integrity: The graph construction and density statement are cited premises; the killed-transfer variation proof is supplied here. A finite arithmetic checker verifies the quadrant derivative images, not the global theorem.
scientific_limitations: Only one-dimensional arclength on the explicitly constructed invariant graph; no ambient planar area, exceptional-set dimension, or uniform escape-rate result. Depends on the published finite-graph and dense-preimage results.
title: Full arclength absorption by flat branches for every parameter in a planar absolute-value family
